test_scenario: Verify that a Teacher can successfully exit a live video session.
test_case_title: Verify Teacher can exit video session
pre_condition: Teacher is logged in, enrolled in the course, and has joined an active video session with at least one student.
expected_result: The Teacher's session terminates, the video streams are ended (if the teacher was the last participant), and the Teacher is redirected to the Landing Page after logout.
post_condition: Teacher is logged out and the video session has ended.

test_steps.step: Teacher clicks the 'Exit' button to leave the session.

uncovered_conditions: Normal Flow: Common Action 5 (Teacher leaves session)
Postcondition: User has participated in the video session and exits the session (Teacher specific)
Alternative Flow: AF2: Teacher Leaves Session (Teacher leaving and terminating streams)
